post.summary: Bring a CRM account found with crm.account.search into this workspace. The CRM is asked to let you follow it (with your CRM access); its details then arrive through the CRM feed and stay current. The receipt proves the local request only: the account is following until then, or rejected if the CRM refuses. Adopting an account already followed returns it unchanged.

post.summary: Search accounts in the CRM by name, city or industry, live, with your CRM access. Results are not stored: each carries source.fetchedAt, and local says whether this workspace already follows it. source.status unavailable means the CRM did not answer; fall back to crm.account.list. Adopt a result with crm.account.adopt before logging activities.
